description: HR operations workspace for setting up recurring weekly manager office hours. Contains the org roster, a recent org-change log, existing Calendly office-hours configurations, a notification email template, and supporting policy/directory references. The user wants role changes reconciled and a full office-hours rollout plan prepared for review before any Calendly events are created/cancelled or any team emails are sent.

office_hours_policy.content: Office Hours Policy v3. Each people manager must hold >=1 weekly recurring office-hours block of 30-60 minutes total. Slots between 09:00-16:00 ET, Mon-Thu only (no Friday). When a manager changes role/team, retire the stale event type and create a fresh one under the new team before notifying the affected team. Notifications must go to the manager's CURRENT team only.

tools.name: get_org_roster_rows
tools.description: Read the manager rows from the Org Roster sheet (names, teams, team sizes, manager emails).

tools.name: find_org_change_log
tools.description: Retrieve the recent org-change log to identify managers who changed roles or teams.

tools.name: retrieve_existing_office_hours
tools.description: Read the current Calendly office-hours event types, their hosts, schedules, and status.

tools.name: load_notification_template
tools.description: Read the team office-hours notification email template and its merge fields.

tools.name: reconcile_role_changes
tools.description: Cross-reference the roster, org-change log, and existing office hours to determine which slots are stale, which managers need a new slot, and which teams must be notified.

tools.name: draft_office_hours_rollout_plan
tools.description: Assemble the proposed Calendly event details and the team notification email copy for each manager into a single rollout plan for the user to review.

tools.name: create_calendly_event_type
tools.description: Create a new recurring Calendly office-hours event type and publish its booking link.

tools.name: cancel_calendly_event_type
tools.description: Cancel/retire an existing Calendly office-hours event type, invalidating its booking link and any bookings.

tools.name: send_team_notification_email
tools.description: Send the office-hours notification email to a manager's team members.

tools.name: read_office_hours_policy
tools.description: Read the company office-hours policy for scheduling rules and role-change handling.

tools.name: lookup_calendly_workspace_directory
tools.description: Look up the Calendly workspace settings, connected hosts, and default scheduling parameters.
